Notes_and_Tips: Include iron-rich plant foods and lean proteins to recover postpartum.
Prefer frequent small meals to manage energy.
Avoid deep-fried and heavily processed foods.
Include gentle postnatal exercises and walk when possible.
Stay hydrated and prioritize sleep where feasible.
